instance_id.description: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDBX instance. This module does NOT create instances - only manages log engine configuration for existing ones.

i18n.zh-Hans: （必填）现有PolarDB-X实例的ID。本模块不创建实例，仅管理现有实例的日志引擎配置。
i18n.en-US: (Required) The ID of the existing PolarDB-X instance. This module does NOT create instances—only manages log engine configuration for existing ones.

enable_log_engine.description: Whether to enable log engine (CDC) configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用日志引擎（CDC）配置。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable the log engine (CDC) configuration.

cdc_node_class.description: The specification for log engine (CDC) nodes. If not specified, the first available CDC class will be used.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志引擎（CDC）节点的规格。如果未指定，则使用第一个可用的CDC类。
i18n.en-US: The specification for log engine (CDC) nodes. If not specified, the first available CDC class will be used.

cdc_node_count.description: The number of log engine (CDC) nodes.

i18n.en-US: The number of log engine (CDC) nodes.

multi_streams.description: List of multi-stream configurations for CDC.
multi_streams.type:
list(object({
    group_name = string
    comment    = optional(string, "")
    hash_level = string
    node_class = string
    node_count = number
  }))

i18n.en-US: List of multi-stream configurations for CDC.
